item.title: Electronically-controlled variable flow valves (US490981022)
item.description:
An electronically-controllable flow valve includes a conduit including a fluid channel with an inlet and an outlet. A projection is connected to an inner surface of the fluid channel. A piezoelectric diaphragm is arranged on an opposing surface of the conduit adjacent to the projection. A piezo actuator is configured to supply power across the piezoelectric diaphragm to vary an opening between the projection and the opposing surface of the fluid channel. The piezo actuator is configured to cause the piezoelectric diaphragm to move to a closed state against the projection to seal the fluid channel. A spring and/or a linear actuator are configured to bias an outer surface of the piezoelectric diaphragm towards the projection. An air suspension system includes air spring assemblies arranged at front and rear suspensions/wheel assemblies and a plurality of the electronically-controllable flow valves.

item.title: Method for strengthening the lateral nasal wall by forming a suture between the bone and cartilaginous structures to increase the lumen of the internal nasal valve area (RU485200433)
item.description:
FIELD: plastic and maxillofacial surgery. SUBSTANCE: lateral and incomplete medial oblique osteotomies is performed with preservation of intact bone bridges between the lines of lateral and medial oblique osteotomies, and ultrasound rhinosculpture of the bone pyramid. Through incisions in the perichondrium on both sides at the caudal edge of the septum, the nasal septum is separated subperichondrially along its entire length. Next, the upper lateral cartilages are separated from the nasal septum from the W-zone to the key zone while preserving the horizontal component of the upper lateral cartilage. Then the nasal septum is lowered by the planned value and a cartilage graft is taken while maintaining an L-shaped frame at least 10 mm wide. Cartilaginous expansion grafts 15–20 mm long and 1.5–2 mm thick are fixed to the septum on each side. Additionally, expanding flaps of the upper lateral cartilages (split spreader flap) are formed and fixed with longitudinal notches and turning inward to create duplication and a springy effect. Using a conical milling cutter attachment from a piezo device, two holes are formed in the caudal part of the bone pyramid on each side in the projection of the lateral key zone at a distance of 3–4 mm from each other. After this, using a PDS 5/0 thread, two interrupted sutures or one Z-shaped suture are placed through the indicated holes between the caudal edge of the bony slope and the cranial edge of the upper lateral cartilage. Additionally, the external valve is strengthened with a short lath graft under the lateral crus of the lower lateral cartilage. Next, the terminal section of the nose is formed according to anatomical landmarks. The skin-muscle flap is placed back in place. The aesthetic result is visually assessed and sutured with PDS 6/0 thread using simple interrupted sutures. Air-conducting intranasal splints are inserted into the nasal cavity and fixed with one interrupted suture; they are removed on an outpatient basis on the seventh day. A strip bandage is applied to the nose and an external thermoplastic nasal splint is fixed in place, which is removed on an outpatient basis on the 14th day. EFFECT: method allows to increase the stability of the lateral nasal wall, prevent functional complications, and ensure improved nasal breathing during structural rhinoseptoplasty in patients with deformation of the lateral nasal wall and respiratory failure. 1 cl, 1 dwg, 1 ex

The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine sampling containers, in particular to a portable coal sample collecting container based on pressure coloring air tightness monitoring, which comprises a tank body, a tank cover in threaded connection with the tank body and a cylinder valve mounted on the tank cover, a conical hole is formed in the tank cover; a monitoring mechanism is further arranged on the can cover and comprises a piezochromic material detachably connected into the conical hole of the can cover, the piezochromic material is in a circular truncated cone shape, the size of the piezochromic material is slightly larger than that of the conical hole, and the upper end of the piezochromic material extends out of the upper surface of the can cover. The lower end face of the piezo-chromic material is flush with the lower surface of the can cover. According to the scheme, the gas pressure in the coal sample tank can be monitored in real time, the coal sample tank can adapt to the high-risk environment with underground coal dust and gas, sampling failure caused by gas leakage of the coal sample tank is avoided, the gas tightness inspection time of the coal sample tank is saved, meanwhile, experimenters can conveniently carry the coal sample tank, and the gas tightness inspection efficiency is improved. The collision damage of the coal sample tank in the transportation process is reduced.

item.title: Piezoelectric valve (EP13241140)
item.description:
A piezoelectric valve having a diaphragm (38) which is kept in contact with a valve seat (52) when a drive signal is not applied to a piezoelectric element (42) to separate diaphragm chambers (24a and 24b) from a passage (54), wherein, even if the pressure of fluid introduced into the diaphragm chambers (24a and 24b) is varied, the diaphragm (38) is firmly supported against the valve seat (52) without causing any deformation, and the passage (54) is closed securely by a cover, whereby eliminating the possibility of fluid leakage. On the other hand, the diaphragm (38) is bent when the drive signal is applied to the piezoelectric element (42) to allow communication of the diaphragm chambers (24 and 24b) with the passage (54) and guide fluid to the passage (54). If the piezoelectric element (42) is forced to bent excessively, it will be kept in contact with a cushion member (56) so as to prevent the piezoelectric element (42) from being deformed excessively, whereby eliminating the possibility of damage to the piezoelectric element(42).

item.title: Piezoelectric bending transducer and its usage (EP12124407)
item.description:
A piezo-electric bending transducer is specified, which is suitable for installation in a valve channel. It consists of at least one ceramic layer, metallised on both sides, with piezo-electric characteristics, which is polarised such that it undergoes a length change when a voltage is applied, and of at least one stiff moulded piece, connected thereto over its surface, with approximately the same surface dimensions, which undergoes either no length expansion or opposite length expansion when a voltage is applied. The piezo-ceramic layer has a non-metallised point with a roughness Ra of less than 0.5 mu m, which covers an opening in the valve channel. The ceramic layer preferably has the form of an elongated strip and the non-metallised point is located at one end of the strip.
